title: Legend of Yukon
overview: In the wild summer lands of the Yukon, a newborn horse takes his first steps into the world. When tragedy strikes, a young foal is forced to run for his life carrying with him the legacy of his mother, the kindness of strangers, and a destiny shaped by survival, loyalty, and courage as the seasons change.
